thread:
elaine (Partnerships): quick heads-up — new open-model provider (DeltaWeights) wants us to list their quantized variants on cloud marketplaces (aws + azure eu) and do an SI bundle with Redwood+EdgeSI. need clarity on payments, geo restrictions, and announcement cadence.
mike_p (PM): is their ask to be a hosted model on Redwood hosted catalog + marketplace listing, or to allow third-party cloud marketplaces to resell copies?
sanjay (Legal): they signed a standard openweights license but attached a commercial addendum. key points: (1) revenue split for marketplace resell must be negotiated, (2) geo-blocking required for sanctioned regions, (3) cannot sublicense source weights to resellers without consent.
tara (BizDev): they want 70/30 rev-share for direct hosted usage, but marketplaces expect 85/15. need to align so we don't block marketplace listing. also SI wants a 10% integration fee on top.
elaine (Partnerships): can we propose a dual-path: Hosted via Redwood (70/30) + Marketplace listing via partner portals with an addendum (85/15) and a clawback/proof-of-use report monthly? thoughts?
sanjay (Legal): we can do dual-path but must add an attribution and provenance clause. require manifest metadata: model_hash, training_data_origin, quantization_profile. also need invoice flow clarified: marketplace pays Redwood, Redwood pays provider — include 30-day settlement term. add export control warranty.
legal-bot: automated check: clause 'geo-blocking' present in DeltaWeights addendum.pdf? No — action: request addendum update.
mike_p (PM): operationally, hosting + marketplace listing changes how we surface model variants. need to surface "marketplace" vs "hosted" SKU in the catalog and routing policy. can we have an entitlement flag so Dedicated customers don't accidentally pull marketplace variants?
tara (BizDev): SI bundle conversation: EdgeSI wants co-branded launch. they asked for a 60-day exclusivity window for joint announcements in APAC. redwood stance?
essential question: will exclusivity block other SI partners in region? Jess, marketing input?
jess (Marketing): 60-day co-announce is fine if DeltaWeights funds the co-marketing slot. require joint press release draft 10 days before launch. we should keep press embargo window aligned across AWS Marketplace listing date and Redwood console rollout.
elaine (Partnerships): next steps: (1) tara to negotiate marketplace split/si fee, (2) sanjay to request updated addendum (geo-block + settlement), (3) mike to add SKU entitlement flag and routing. jess to schedule co-marketing checklist.
tara (BizDev): will try to get marketplace split to 80/20 baseline and push SI fee to 12% instead of 10. ping me if legal needs negotiation notes.
sanjay (Legal): drafting addendum request: please include explicit warranty re: export control, and clause: "No sublicensing of weights to third-party resellers without written consent from provider." sending to DeltaWeights legal.
mike_p (PM): created internal ticket: RD-OPS-8763 to add catalog entitlement flag + marketplace boolean; ETA 2 weeks for UI + routing tests.
elaine (Partnerships): thanks team. I'll sync with DeltaWeights and come back with their revised addendum. tagging @tara @sanjay @mike_p @jess — please update by EOD Wed. :thumbsup:
